title: Voice session
idea: A raised eyebrow and a compact speech signal make listening feel attentive.
rationale: Doddy leans in through his eyes and eyebrow; the speech signal distinguishes listening from speaking.
motion: Update the signal only when speech data changes. Replace the mouth when speech starts.

title: Focus timer
idea: A steady countdown with a gently knowing face and one clear next action.
rationale: Time remains primary; a smaller task line gives purpose and the pause state feels deliberate.
motion: Tabular digits update without shifting; progress stops when paused.

title: Playback
idea: Small headphones and a precise playback rail keep Doddy present without taking over.
rationale: Playback controls share one stable group; progress and expression distinguish playing from paused.
motion: Progress advances with actual playback; freeze the marks when paused.

title: Companion session
idea: A raised eyebrow and an offered hand give the ongoing conversation a recognisable presence.
rationale: The session stays bounded. Open goes to the conversation; thinking is distinct from speaking.
motion: A thought marker appears during processing; updates replace it with the current state.

title: Orbit
idea: An orbit becomes a quiet instrument for activity and remaining time.
rationale: An elliptical orbit belongs to Doddy’s face; its orange marker has a defined data role.
motion: Voice uses a short active segment. Focus arc encodes remaining fraction. No decorative continuous loop.

title: Ink Ripple
idea: Speech becomes two soft ink envelopes; focus settles the contours.
rationale: Contour amplitude represents speech energy; the focus variant is flatter and carries a progress marker.
motion: Cap speech-driven amplitude; hold a quiet contour between updates.

title: Negative Space
idea: A cream hand presents a black cutout, with an orange point carrying the state.
rationale: Doddy’s hand offers the phrase; a black slot carved into a cream form turns progress into negative space.
motion: Move the small state point only with activity updates. Gesture is a static signature.

title: Kinetic Ribbon
idea: One ribbon folds with speech and straightens into a measured focus rail.
rationale: A single controlled fold expresses speech; a straightened ribbon makes focus progress precise.
motion: Replace a fold with a new shape on speech updates; never use arbitrary wandering curves.

title: Editorial
idea: Beautiful numerals, a tiny Doddy signature and a precise editorial caret.
rationale: Typography leads. A caret means capture is active; the focus rail is exact and quiet.
motion: Caret changes with capture state. Use numeric content replacement for the countdown.

title: Abstract Landscape
idea: A curved cream horizon and orange sun make progress feel like a small journey.
rationale: The sun is a progress marker, not scenery decoration; voice and focus use the same restrained horizon.
motion: The marker changes position with state/progress. Keep the horizon still.

title: Thought Drop
idea: A thought gathers into a cream vessel, then resolves into a saved mark.
rationale: Gathering orange points represent capture; the same vessel becomes a clear completion symbol.
motion: A brief content update changes capture points to a check. End the confirmation promptly.

title: Language Bridge
idea: Two language anchors and one bridge make translation unmistakable.
rationale: EN and FR anchors explain the bridge; a small listening face becomes a knowing, ready-to-play face.
motion: The orange bridge completes when translation is ready. Play opens a separate narration state.

title: Reminder Pin
idea: A clock pin becomes a neatly confirmed reminder, with time still readable.
rationale: A pin and compact time connect the setup to its outcome without filling the island with a note card.
motion: Pin settles once on confirmation. End setup; deliver the future reminder as a notification.

title: Step Path
idea: A three-step path gives a task a beginning and a clear next move.
rationale: One active orange node and two quiet cream nodes encode three concrete steps; no ornamental dots.
motion: Node changes only on completion. Plan-ready opens the full task breakdown.

title: Spoken Mark
idea: Quotation strokes and a word marker give reading aloud a distinctive rhythm.
rationale: Quotation marks identify readout; progress reflects playback and freezes in the paused view.
motion: Update a word marker with narration; keep the static quotation signature.

variants.label: PAUSED
variants.context: Pick up where you left off

title: Calm Pulse
idea: A calm face and an expanding phase arc offer a clear one-minute reset.
rationale: Phase words remain essential; an arc supports inhale/exhale without pretending to be a medical metric.
motion: Phase change may use a bounded transition. Reduced motion keeps phase words and time visible.
